name: Western University
summary: Gothic-style campus in London, Ontario, with 42,000+ students from 134 countries and 450 majors, minors and specializations across 11 faculties.

ib.text: Complete IB Diploma with TOK and EE, at least six subjects (three HL), a total of 27 or more including EE and TOK, no mark below 4, and the required courses for your program.

dates.label: OUAC deadline for equal consideration, full-time undergraduate studies

programmes.name: Medical Sciences
programmes.about: A first-entry science route through the Faculty of Science into the Bachelor of Medical Sciences, taught with the Schulich School of Medicine & Dentistry. Complete Medical Sciences 1 and 2 and Year 3 BMSc is assured.
programmes.ib: Biology, Chemistry and Maths (any) at HL or SL are required; Physics is recommended. About 1,000 first-year places.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on grades; Ontario applicants' guideline is a mid-to-high 80s average, which Western does not give in IB points. 27 is the Diploma floor.

flagshipSource.title: Medical Sciences first entry: about 1,000 first-year places and assured Year 3 entry to the BMSc

programmes.name: Engineering
programmes.about: A common first year for all engineering students, then you rank your choice of discipline, from Civil and Mechanical to Software and Mechatronic Systems. Co-op and internship options, plus combined degrees with business or law.
programmes.ib: Chemistry and Physics at HL or SL, and Maths AA (HL or SL) or AI HL; the Casper test is required before any offer.
programmes.selectionNote: Grades plus the mandatory Casper situational-judgment test; Ontario applicants' guideline is a high-80s to low-90s average, not given in IB points.

flagshipSource.title: Engineering first entry: common first year, about 850 first-year places, co-op and internship available

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering
faculties.line: Chemistry, Physics and Maths required; the Casper test is mandatory and an offer cannot come without a result.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: Maths and a science at HL or SL; Biology and Chemistry needed for first-year Bio/Chem; Medical Sciences adds Biology, Chemistry, Maths.

faculties.name: Faculty of Social Science
faculties.line: No required courses; Economics modules need Maths AA, or AI HL, and Psychology benefits from Maths.

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts & Humanities
faculties.line: No required courses; Studio Fine Arts needs a portfolio and the School for Advanced Studies a statement of interest.

faculties.name: Faculty of Health Sciences
faculties.line: Health Sciences needs Biology and Maths; Nursing needs Biology, Chemistry, English and Maths; Kinesiology needs Biology.

faculties.name: Management & Organizational Studies
faculties.line: Maths (any) at HL or SL; Commercial Aviation Management adds a supplementary form. Ivey HBA is entered after first or second year.

faculties.name: Music
faculties.line: An audition and/or interview is required for all Music programs; registration closes 1 February.

notes: Western estimates year-1 international tuition and fees at CAD 48,000 to 64,400 (2025-26 rates); international rates rise by no more than 4% a year after year 1.
The IB total of 27 includes the Extended Essay and TOK bonus points, unlike Toronto and Queen's.
Ivey's Honours Business Administration is not a first-year entry; apply to Western first and enter it after first or second year.
